name: Chef & My Fridge
description: The best chefs of Korea compete to create impromptu dishes that feature ingredients found inside the guest stars' personal refrigerators.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Please Take Care of My Refrigerator is a 2014 South Korean cooking-variety program starring by many chefs and celebrity guests. It airs on JTBC on Mondays at 21:30 beginning November 17, 2014.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Chef & My Fridge and the Culinary Class Wars crew sate appetites in under 15 minutes. Opening day is chaos! New rules, same old delicious fun.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Calm Down man says scallions are okay, but not scallion kimchi! Roi Choi is taking his sweet time, and the chefs are going all in. This won't be easy.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Actors Song Joong-ki and Lee Hee-jun fling open their fridges! Champ Kwon Seong-joon lends a hand as masters of Chinese cuisine go head-to-head.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Song Joong-ki's fridge reveals ingredients never seen before! In a match between Kwon Seong-joon and Sam Kim, a risotto must be served in 15 minutes.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Gen Z superstars Jang Won-young and Lee Eun-ji reveal their diet! A Michelin chef turns the heat up, and a duel proves these chefs aren’t all talk.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Is something growing in Lee Eun-ji's fridge? After a match between the speediest and the slowest chefs, Kim Poong's creation will shock the guest.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The charismatic Son Suk-ku and Hyun Bong-sik offer up their fridges. Edward Lee returns for a revenge match with the culinary master Kwon Seong-joon.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Why is there soju in the non-drinker Hyun Bong-sik's fridge? A Michelin two-star chef challenges the winningest chef on the show in an epic battle.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The secret to ageless beauty lies in Ha Ji-won’s fridge. As her old acquaintance Jang Keun-suk watches, the chefs wage a mighty war against aging.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: A little spice hurt no one in Jang Keun-suk’s mind! A spicy battle ensues for this connoisseur of pepper and swagger. Fine dining is about to get hot.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Global stars J-Hope and Heo Sung-tae open their fridges. Chef Kim So-hyi is ready to hunt; Kim Poong is eager to win. An epic dessert battle ensues!

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Heo Sung-tae has a charming hidden side, and his fridge is a battleground for Italian cuisine. Today, after 12 years, two chefs will face off again.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Hot and single Lee Da-hee and Dex are in the house! Will there be 6 straight wins? Choi Kang-rok airs a brand new self, and a K-cuisine battle ensues.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Ex-marine Choi Kang-rok challenges former UDT Dex to arm wrestling. A lavish Jeolla-do spread and a topsy-turvy in-flight meal are also in the works!

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Spring brings Cha Jun-hwan and Jung Jae-hyung to the table. Even a light eater will turn big at today's meal. Kim Poong serves another unhinged dish.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Jung Jae-hyung’s fridge is as extravagant as can be! Can the slowpoke Choi Kang-rok manage 12 servings in 15 minutes? A French cuisine battle follows.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The fun couple Choi Yang-rak and Paeng Hyun-Sook are here with Park Myung-soo. The Queen of Dimsum has a challenger, and so does the reigning king!

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Park Myung Soo is ready to run his mouth! Will the original Italian Matfia Fabri take down Kwon Seong Joon? A nutty but tasty battle takes place.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Here's to the 2002 World Cup! Kim Nam-il and Lee Dong-gook bring ingredients and soccer trauma to the table. The return match will commence via food.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Lee Dong-gook’s fridge is filled to the brim, but nothing there is for him. The chefs hold their revenge to serve a special dish for this family man.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: The greatest chefs will serve the greatest stars of Asia! Kim Jae-joong, Choo Sung-hoon and special chef Jang Keun-suk are all in for the big match.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Two chefs clash in a battle of authentic Italian cuisine, followed by a face-off between Asia’s top chefs. Choo Sung-hoon unleashes his wild appetite.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Hoshi, Woozi and Oh My Girl Mimi are in the house. Seventeen is known to eat themselves out of house and home! How will this anniversary cook-off go?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Mimi has a sweet tooth! Her fridge is a battleground for masters of Chinese cuisine. The sweetest fight follows between Jung Ho-young and Kim Poong.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Lee Se-dol and Lee Chan-won reveal their fridges. But Lee Se-dol has a list of items he can’t stand! How will the chefs please his sugar-free palate?

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Trot prodigy Lee Chan-won is as skilled in the kitchen as he is on stage. His fridge deserves both the finest performance and the best dishes.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Sunwoo Yong-nyeo and Lee Joon are on opposite ends of the lifestyle spectrum. After a battle of the brunches, chefs go all out with quality seafood.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Lee Joon is known to lead a modest life. What's a home-cooked meal that can be eaten in 15 minutes? Who'll take on the mantle of cafeteria head chef?

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Doh Kyung-soo is a former army cook? If so, then let the seafood cook-off begin! But can Son Jong-won withstand Kim Poong's relentless attacks?

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Park Byung-eun is a fisherman at heart, with 500 jukkumis under his belt! Today’s cook-off showcases the freshest prime ingredients that he's caught.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: BTS Jin is known for his good looks and his cooking chops! To cater to his tastes, Edward Lee and Yoon Nam-no serve mulhoe that’s out of this world.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Will the champagne in Jo Se-ho’s fridge see the light of day? After some Mexican cuisine, the young masters of Chinese cuisine are ready to battle.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Lim Yoon-a's criteria? Performance and attitude. A fierce cooking battle unfolds in her refrigerator as everyone unleashes their secret weapons!

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Former boxer Ahn Bo-hyun packs a hard punch as an appetizer. For the main course, the chefs showcase power and endless performance with their cooking.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Car, the Garden, the man of many nicknames, opens his fridge. The Shaolin chefs fire up the kitchen as Kim Poong creates yet another weird concoction.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Pani Bottle has 71 countries under his belt! His fridge boasts all kinds of ingredients, and his liquor selection rivals that of a duty-free shop.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Like her iconic role, Lee Young-ae embraces the organic lifestyle by eating off the land! Her fresh and natural ingredients spark a healthy battle.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Kim Young-kwang buys anything that sounds good! Two chefs go rogue in his overflowing fridge as Kim Poong whips up another nightmare of a dish.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: K-pop stars NCT Chenle and Mark open their fridge for the rivaling chefs. A fierce cook-off awaits, including the season’s first-ever team battle.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Global stars Stray Kids showcase their fridge and some unexpected charms. After a legendary dessert battle, one chef begins to impersonate another!

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: The actors are in the house! Jo Woo-jin is a menace onscreen but a doting husband in real life. He orders a dish burning with love for his dear wife.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Chuseok brings notable guests. President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung sample seasonal dishes made by the greatest chefs in South Korea.
